_comment: Shared case table for the tool-call title derivation. Read by website/src/utils/toolCallTitle.test.ts and test/test_tool_call_title.py so the TypeScript and Python implementations cannot disagree. `title` is the English rendering; `action` null means the incoming title is kept (or, for shell, the raw command is shown). Regenerate with the generator in the PR description, or edit by hand.

cases.name: cat single file (src skipped in display name)
sed with tilde path is not literal
cd then relative read resolves against cwd
cat with two operands stays raw
ls with stderr silenced and head dropped
leading echo dropped in a chain
rg with no pattern stays raw
read piped to grep = read and 1 more
any unknown segment falls back to raw

rawInput.command: cd website && npm test && echo done

expect.title: cd website && npm test && echo done

rawInput.command: cd "$KIROCREW_SCRATCH/codex" && git ls-files | grep -i parse_command | head

expect.title: cd "$KIROCREW_SCRATCH/codex" && git ls-files | grep -i parse_command | head

cases.name: redirect rejects (first line, ellipsis for more lines)
long unparseable command is cut on a word boundary

rawInput.command: for a in b36e0749 dfeb1997; do echo "=== $a"; tail -c 3800 /home/u/.kiro/crew/subagents/$a/result.txt; done

expect.title: for a in b36e0749 dfeb1997; do echo "=== $a"; tail -c 3800…

cases.name: git diff range without pathspec has no path
git push branch is a ref not a path
gh issue create with valued flags

rawInput.command: gh issue create --repo o/r --title t --body-file f
gh label list --repo o/r --limit 300 --json name --jq '.[].name' | grep -i area

cases.name: gh with only a noun is raw
live kiro-cli title carries the command
live kiro-cli title with no kind and no input is still a shell
live kiro-cli heredoc title falls back to its first line
